title: Engineering Delivery Excellence Platform | Faros

hero.headline: Predictable delivery roadmap — achieve strategic business outcomes.
hero.subhead: Create transparency, predictability, and consistency across cross-team engineering initiatives.

sections.heading: How we help
sections.body: Deliver on time with centralized progress tracking and forecasting; optimize resource allocation with AI capacity insights; get ahead of blockers with real-time dependency tracking.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: Connect disjointed data across tools (including non-standardized Jira) into one source of truth; monitor progress across projects/features/epics; auto-fix data hygiene issues.

sections.heading: Predictability
sections.body: Analyze real-time data and historical trends to raise red flags; early warning on predicted delays and budget overruns; dependency management.

sections.heading: Forecasting
sections.body: Full visibility into time/resource allocation across products, initiatives, geographies; track time on roadmap, KTLO, security, bugs, tech debt.

sections.heading: Efficiency (agile health)
sections.body: Sprint throughput, WIP, goal attainment; planning and retro dashboards; personalized AI recommendations addressing team constraints.

sections.heading: Capitalization
sections.body: Audit-ready software cost capitalization reports by initiative, epic, or employee; consistent capitalization rules; real-time audit trails.

sections.heading: Coverage highlights
sections.body: Initiative tracking (cost/revenue impact, budget overrun prediction), agile health (say/do ratios, planned vs unplanned), workforce optimization (team composition, 'ghost engineers', vendor benchmarks), SWE cost capitalization.

notes: A fifth named capability surface not represented in the seed tree's three pillars: predictable delivery / initiative tracking / capacity forecasting / cost capitalization. Reads as shipped product. This corroborates persona Maya's 'govern without slowing down' and board-facing pressures but is operationally a planning/PMO surface rather than the Observe/Optimize/Govern AI-token thesis — propose as faros nodes with honesty 'shipped' but flag that it sits outside the seed tree's pillar taxonomy. FAQ here states '100+ tools' integration count. Testimonial: Tal Levinger, Agile Program Manager, Riskified.
